author: Hamburger123598
body:
Hello, I have been recently encountering what I believe to be an error, when I login to the server I can play for a short amount of time, then I am kicked for 'Tempbanned by icejjfish Enforcing Tempban July 21st 2014' Then when I try to login I get the message from 'Vacuum > Be nice to other players' I believe these are because of a glitch. I haven't played on your servers for a few weeks and when I did I was respectful nor was I infringing upon any rules to the best of my knowledge.

IGN: Hamburger123598

Reason I was Temp Banned: I have no idea, as mentioned above the date of this is July 21st 2014. Up until this point in time I have been able to play on Avicus freely which is quite odd...

Why I Should Be Unbanned From Avicus: I feel as though I am a valued and respected member among the community not to mention that I try my very hardest to follow rules and respect staff members and players. I faintly remember seeing a screen like the ban screen mentioned above before sometime around July and I do believe I have served my punishment and learned from the mistakes I had made.

Thank you for considering my appeal for an unban,

Hamburger123598


A link to the ban screen can be found here: http://gyazo.com/ec16bdf61458c7116faaf33db7403dd4

title: Hamburger123598 Appealing a Glitch Ban

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hamburger.

This is just a console glitch.

Console likes to kick people for old infractions. The infractions you are seeing are just old ones.

This is a known bug and you just have to try to live with it. 

And about that ban, it's not really a ban. As i said it's an old infraction. Try re-joining the server it will work.

replies.body:
ok, thank you very much for your speedy reply!

I just hope that I won't be kicked as often for these glitch bans :/ its quite annoying when I am in the middle of a game and I get kicked from it when i have good armor and weapons or something. This is especially evident in The Walls.

Thank you anyways,

Hamburger123598
